applies_why: The judge's UNDERDETERMINED rests on the defender having dropped the curse limb, not on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. When one verse's words carry two meanings at once, both stand; the verse is not open.
why: The stated ground is the dropped link, not a single verse's silence, so K-S2 does not forbid this disposition.
